_doc: ONE source of truth for every hero/heroine sprite motion (idle, walk, run, dodge, attacks ...). Rows are pixel rows on the 768x432 sprite grid (= 2x the 384x216 live logical grid); row 0 = top pixel of the head (crown), the sole line is the row BELOW the last foot pixel (so a standing body occupies rows 0..59 = 60 px). x is relative to the body centre column. Every motion is drawn by tools/hero_v3_pix.py against these rows; only 'bob' (whole upper body dy, +down) and 'lean' (forward shear above the belt) may move them, and only by the per-frame amounts listed in the motion table. Timing: every hold is in 60 fps game ticks. Gait anims are distance-synced exactly like the game (town/tools/game.template.html: walkT += dt*max(.6, speed/FEEL.walkSpeed)*(run ? FEEL.runStride : 1)), so 'ticks' here are anim ticks at the reference speed of that gait.

female._doc: the 7 heroines: SAME grid; differences only: 2 px shorter at the crown (crown row 2, head 12 -> chin 14 shared), narrower shoulders, narrower waist, wider hips. Crotch, knee, sole rows are identical so legs stay long (owner ref user_proportion_ref.png).

walk._doc: 24 anim ticks at walk speed = 0.400 s, 86.0 world px = 51.6 grid px per cycle -> 25.8 grid px per step; drawn planted-foot travel ~6.4 px/frame (no sliding).

run._doc: 24 anim ticks; anim rate at full run = runMul*runStride = 1.9*0.55 = 1.045 anim ticks per game tick -> 2.87 real ticks per frame, 22.97 real ticks = 0.383 s per cycle, 93.9 grid px (156 world px) per cycle at 245 grid px/s. Chosen (instead of the old 4-tick / 208 px cycle) so the drawn stance-foot sweep (~10.6 px/frame) matches the ground travel (11.7 px/frame). Ground phase 2 frames/step, float 1 frame/step.

dodge._doc: same holds as hero_anim.src.json dash_* (2,3,3,3,4,6). Game: FEEL.dashTicks 13 real ticks of travel (frames 0-4 = the first 15 anim ticks are stretched over them: tick = t/dashTicks*(21-6)), then FEEL.dashRecTicks 6 = frame 5 recovery. Travel = integral of max(820*(1-p)^2*1.5+90, carry) over 13 ticks = 108 world px = 65 grid px (walk start). Ghost trail: game draws it (every 2 ticks, 0.24 s fade); previews draw it the same way.
bob/lean beyond +-1 are allowed ONLY here (crouch).

slots._doc: paperdoll slots of the hand-built rig (EQUIPMENT.md 'layer paperdoll' + corruption / 마왕 강림 set). Every frame exports anchors (frames/*.json 'anchors': crown, eye, neck, capeRoot, belt, hip, handR/L, kneeR/L, ankleR/L in sprite-canvas px) and a part map (grp ids) so any slot can be drawn on the SAME frames later. z = draw order inside one frame (higher = nearer); per-view order follows EQUIPMENT.md.

order.left: right mirrored geometry (drawn natively: pauldron + light stay correct)

anchorsBySlot.cape: capeRoot (variants: royal = current, tattered = 찢어진 어둠 망토: same polygon, hem cut by a noise mask)
anchorsBySlot.back_attach: capeRoot (심연의 촉수 tentacles: drawn behind the cape in down/right, above it in up)
anchorsBySlot.weapon: handR (종언 greatsword; side view = near hand, z above near arm)
anchorsBySlot.aura_back/aura_front: hip (particles behind/in front of the body)
anchorsBySlot.shadow: ankle midpoint on the sole row (3-headed dragon shadow at 각인 6+)
